def _design(taus, dt, times, hist, hold, aligned, initial):
    after = np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1] - dt
    kernel = np.exp(-after[:, None] / taus) * (-np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / taus))
    memory = hist @ kernel + initial * np.exp(-np.sum(dt) / taus)
    delta = hold[:, None] - memory
